issue.title: Truth-up agent docs and theme conventions to match main
issue.body:
## Summary

Agent onboarding docs and Cursor rules still describe an older launch path and screen map. Theme guidance still points new UI at `appStyles` hex dumps instead of `src/theme` tokens.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document actual launch: `initializeDatabase` → `restoreSession` → navigator; sync post-login (not cold-start `syncAllData` as the only path)
- [ ] Update screen/path map to current `src/app/screens/` + `src/app/tabs/` (Home, Drafting, Sync, Settings, etc.)
- [ ] Fix `code-style.mdc` to use `getApiBaseUrl()` (not non-existent `API_BASE_URL` named export)
- [ ] Align `architecture.mdc` / `project-overview.mdc` launch + screen wording with code
- [ ] Document `src/theme` as canonical for new UI; do not add new hardcoded hex in new styles; `appStyles` is legacy until migrated by touch

## Out of scope

Runtime refactors, full `appStyles` rewrite, migration framework (#110).
